newsitem.title: USA: TVA offers $1.35 bln debt exchange.
newsitem.headline: TVA offers $1.35 bln debt exchange.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) said on Monday that it launched an offer to exchange up to $1.35 billion principal amount of 5.88 percent power bonds for 5.98 percent bonds issued in 1996 to reduce the electricity producer's interest expense.
TVA is offering to exchange 5.88 percent Power Bonds 1997 Series C, due April 1, 2036, for outstanding 5.98 percent Power Bonds 1996 Series A due April 1, 2036, it said in a statement.
TVA said the new bonds mature in 2036 and provide two opportunities for early redemption. They have a first redemption date of April 1, 1999, rather than April 1, 1998.
April 3, 2006 is the second redemption date, a company spokesman said.
The original bonds were issued in April 1996, reopened in July of 1996 and reopened again in November 1996 in response to high investor demand, TVA said.
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc is the exclusive Dealer Manager for the exchange. D.F. King & Co Inc is the Information Agent.
